digest.component_or_area: MCP read surface - list_tickets, ready_tickets, search
propositions: list_tickets and ready_tickets return unbounded payloads exceeding 90KB client budget, causing transport close with no structured error signal
Unfiltered list_tickets on deployed endpoint returned 94.5MB in one response; client abandonment is indistinguishable from server failure because server offers no size bound or structured refusal
Lean projection omits only description/comments but retains 88% bulk (authorship_ledger, attestations, signature, keyring), making per-row size 15,548 bytes instead of achievable 1,726

Budget measurement was 178% underestimating wire payload: raw dicts measured before model_validate which re-adds declared defaults and before js_safe_result formatting and FastMCP's dual-emission doubling
List tools must refuse (not truncate) over-budget results via structured RebarError with response_too_large code, since short lists are indistinguishable from complete ones
search tool shares the unbounded discovery problem and must also be bound with per-tool remedy guidance for narrowing
